spec_match.rationale: Queries the exact codecs-parameter space IAMF spec 6.4 defines (Opus / mp4a.40.2 / fLaC / ipcm across primary_profile 000/001/002) through the real decodingInfo() surface named by the chromestatus entry.

interactive.rationale: Query-type select plus a run button fire 15 real decodingInfo() calls that populate the table and the live status line; nothing is a lookup table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises real per-codec-string decodingInfo answers with supported/smooth/powerEfficient, which is exactly what the cells render.

edge_cases.rationale: Baseline non-IAMF rows disambiguate a trustworthy negative from a broken probe; the status line distinguishes no-API, all-negative-with-working-baselines, and no-baseline-decodable states.

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry and spec section 6.4 directly; the feature index carries the full reference set.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite asserts resolve-not-reject for valid IAMF strings, MSE-door agreement, and malformed-string refusal — contracts this page exercises, all passing 8/8 in the verification browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP-driven headless Chromium 141 run: 15/15 queries answered, all 12 IAMF cells honestly 'not supported', 2/3 baselines supported (opus/flac in MP4), console and network clean; desktop and 360x740 DPR3 mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: iamf-matrix-ran asserts all 15 answers with counts in details; the missing-API branch asserts iamf-matrix-fallback-no-api separately.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables throughout, emerald darkened via color-mix for AA on paper, page-local button override sets background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: Native select/button with labels, caption plus scoped th on the table, role=status aria-live=polite results line announcing the final verdict.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: After fixing a select-driven min-content overflow (scrollWidth 418 to 360), the emulated 360x740 DPR3 run lays out cleanly with the table scrolling inside its own overflow-x wrapper; desktop 1280x800 verified via responsive-check.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the success path on an IAMF-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: Every cell honestly reports unsupported on Chromium 141 (no ENABLE_IAMF_TOOLS). When a Chrome 153+ or iamf-tools build is available, re-run the matrix behind --enable-features=IamfAudioDecoding and confirm supported cells render smooth/powerEfficient flags correctly.

guidanceConsulted.query: async feature detection status updates aria live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic tables with caption/th scope, native controls with explicit labels, and announce async results via a polite live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table has caption and scoped th cells for both axes; the status line is role=status aria-live=polite and updates once with the final verdict after the batch completes.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive results table matrix mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide data belongs in its own scroll container; grid/flex chains need min-width:0 so intrinsic widths cannot widen the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Table lives in an overflow-x:auto wrapper; a real overflow from the select's intrinsic option width was found at 360px (scrollWidth 418) and fixed with min-width:0 down the chain plus shorter option labels, re-measured to 360.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP measurement before/after: scrollW 418 -> 360 at 360x740 DPR3

summary: Basic/canonical angle: the full spec 6.4 codec-string space asked through the real decodingInfo() surface with baseline rows making the negative trustworthy. Verified via CDP-driven headless Chromium 141 (sanctioned cloud fallback; chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable): 15/15 answered, honest all-unsupported IAMF block, clean console/network, both device classes screenshotted and read, one real mobile overflow found and fixed during review.
